Forwarding Ortus thread — they sent token traces. I ran quick arithmetic and options; paste of core calc below. Please review and flag anything that needs ops/finance input before I send the recommendation to the customer.

--- Begin calc / recommendations (conservative baseline) ---
Assumptions 
- Model: Llama-13B q4f16 (production-verified on Redwood Dedicated)
- GPU profile: A100/80GB-equivalent (continuous batch kernels)
- Average prompt+generation: 192 tokens per call (per customer)
- Customer peak tokens/sec target: 34,560 tps
- Measured per-GPU throughput (sampled generation, 192 token target): 900 tokens/sec (conservative baseline)

Raw GPUs required = ceil(34,560 / 900) = 38 GPUs
Operational headroom: 25% -> 38 * 1.25 = 47.5 -> recommend 48 GPUs reserved slab

Latency implications
- With continuous batching and a target batching window ~12–30ms, a 48-GPU slab running the 13B q4f16 profile should hit p95 generation latency in the ~220–280ms range for the 192-token scenario.
- If Ortus needs p95 < 200ms, we recommend either: (a) move to a faster model family (7B distilled variant) which can double per-GPU throughput, or (b) increase slab to ~64 GPUs to reduce queueing and batch tail effects.

Cost / tradeoffs (summary)
- Reserved 48 GPUs (12 mo): best $/token but needs commit.
- Dedicated 48 GPUs with 20% burst pool: gives safety for short spikes (cost + modest premium).
- Hybrid: reserve 36 GPUs + autoscale pool for +12 GPUs to cover peaks — lower commit, slightly higher unit cost.

Runway / rollout plan
1) Canary: 8 GPUs (validate end-to-end, telemetry hooks, cold-starts). 2 days smoke then ramp to 25% traffic.
2) Pilot steady-state: 24 GPUs for first 2–4 weeks, collect p95/tail metrics and KV cache hit-rate.
3) Production reserved slab: 48 GPUs with autoscaling policies and fallback model policy (7B) for regional failures.

Next steps for deliverable to customer
- I will attach the CSV-backed calc sheet and a PDF proposal with the 48 GPU reserved option + hybrid alternative. Ben: can you draft baseline discount tiers for a 12‑month reserve at 48 gpus? Marissa: flag any finance review items. Markus: ops checklist (canary playbook + runbooks) would be great.

--- End calc / recommendations ---
